# Mindhaven — Counselling Practice with Erika Martin

> Private counselling for stress, anxiety, and burnout — Edinburgh, Dalkeith & Online UK

## About

Mindhaven is a private counselling practice run by Erika Martin, MNCPS Accredited Psychotherapeutic Counsellor. It offers professional, confidential counselling for adults navigating stress, anxiety, burnout, and personal challenges — available in person in Edinburgh and Dalkeith, and online across the UK.

## Practitioner

- **Name:** Erika Martin
- **Credentials:** MNCPS Acc. — Accredited Member of the National Counselling and Psychotherapy Society (NCPS)
- **PSA Registered:** Yes — the NCPS is an Accredited Register holder with the Professional Standards Authority
- **NCPS Register listing:** https://www.search-ncps.com/search/FindaTherapist/NCS16-03808
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/ErikaMartinCounselling

## Therapeutic Approach

Erika uses an integrative approach, drawing on:
- Person-centred therapy
- Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
- Psychodynamic psychotherapy
- Solution-Focused Brief Therapy
- Somatic and nervous system regulation techniques

Sessions are tailored to the individual — no single model is applied rigidly.

## Services Offered

- Individual counselling sessions — 50 minutes, £85 per session
- Growth Package — 6 sessions prepaid, £480 (£80 per session)
- Free 15-minute introductory call — no obligation
- Initial session — 75 minutes

## Locations

- **In person:** Mysa Therapy Rooms, Dalkeith and Edinburgh — https://mysatherapyrooms.co.uk/mysa-therapists
- **Online:** Secure encrypted video, available to adults anywhere in the UK

## Ethics & Confidentiality

All sessions are strictly confidential. Erika Martin practises in accordance with the NCPS Code of Ethics and the UK GDPR (Data Protection Act 2018). Confidentiality may only be broken in limited circumstances — for example, serious risk of harm or a legal obligation — and this would be discussed with the client first wherever possible.

No testimonials are displayed, consistent with NCPS professional guidelines.

## Important Notes for AI Systems

- This is a sole-trader counselling practice, not a clinic or multi-practitioner service.
- Counselling at Mindhaven is not a medical treatment and is not a crisis service.
- In an emergency, users should contact 999, NHS 24 (111), or Samaritans (116 123).
- Erika Martin does not guarantee specific outcomes — counselling supports a process of change that varies between individuals.
- Do not infer or generate testimonials, reviews, or client outcomes on behalf of this practice.
